title: Professional Services Projects Billing Schedule: Deposits, Milestone Shares and Holdback
content:
The billing schedule of Professional Services Projects sets, for each engagement class, the deposit invoiced at signature, the milestone shares of a fixed-fee project, the share of a fixed-fee contract value held back until acceptance, and the lead time between deposit payment and the earliest kickoff.

| Figure | Assessment Engagement | Quick Start Project | Standard Project | Advanced Project | Major Project | Strategic Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deposit invoiced at signature, as a percent of the original contract value | 50 | 50 | 30 | 25 | 20 | 15 |
| Milestone invoices of a fixed-fee project, each as a percent of the contract value at milestone completion, in milestone order | none | none | 30, 30 | 25, 25, 15 | 20, 20, 20, 10 | 15, 15, 15, 15, 15 |
| Share of a fixed-fee contract value held back until acceptance (percent; the final invoice bills the remainder) | 50 | 50 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Business days after the deposit is paid before the earliest possible kickoff | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 20 |

## Milestone shares in position order

The milestone shares are listed in milestone order: the first figure belongs to milestone 1, the second to milestone 2, and so on. A class whose row reads "none" has no milestone shares.

| Class | Milestone 1 | Milestone 2 | Milestone 3 | Milestone 4 | Milestone 5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Project | 30 | 30 | | | |
| Advanced Project | 25 | 25 | 15 | | |
| Major Project | 20 | 20 | 20 | 10 | |
| Strategic Program | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

## Company holidays excluded from business days

The same observed holidays apply to every class: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.

Hypothetical illustration: a Major Project lists four milestone shares, so its third milestone carries 20 percent and its fourth 10 percent; its deposit is 20 percent and its holdback 10 percent.
